info.title: OnDemand Spatial Earthquake Search (USGS)
info.description: Search recent or historical earthquakes from the USGS FDSN Event Web Service by time window (UTC), magnitude range and geographic area — a circle (latitude + longitude + maxradiuskm) or a bounding box (minlatitude/maxlatitude/minlongitude/maxlongitude), never both. Returns observed events (id, UTC origin time, magnitude and type, depth km, lat/lon, place, tsunami flag, PAGER alert, USGS URL) plus a provenance block with the exact upstream request URL and the public-domain licence note; `mode=count` returns only the number of matching events. This is the OnDemand tool envelope over the Gate 3 route /api/sources/earthquakes (same adapter, same validation, same structured failures: invalid_query 400, usgs_rejected 400/404, usgs_unavailable 502/5xx, usgs_timeout 504). No authentication; USGS data are in the public domain. Results are capped at 200 events per call.

conversationStarters: List earthquakes above magnitude 4.5 in the last 24 hours
Any earthquakes within 500 km of Abu Dhabi (lat 24.45, lon 54.65) this month?
Show the strongest earthquakes in the Gulf of Mexico box 18..31 N, -98..-80 E since 2025-01-01, largest first
x-ondemand-spatial.auth: none — same-origin proxy; upstream credentials stay server-side

get.summary: Search USGS earthquakes by time window, magnitude and area (circle or bbox)
get.description: All parameters are optional. A circle search (latitude + longitude + maxradiuskm, all three) and a bounding-box search (minlatitude/maxlatitude/minlongitude/maxlongitude) are mutually exclusive; mixing them, a partial circle or an inverted box is a 400 `invalid_query`. Times are UTC. `mode=count` returns `count` only (no events). The answer carries `data.events` (normalised USGS features: id, time_utc, magnitude, mag_type, depth_km, lat, lon, place, tsunami 0|1, alert, url) and `provenance` (source, exact upstream URL, USGS generated time, retrieved_at_utc, public-domain licence). Failures keep the Gate 3 route's status and code: 400 usgs_rejected/invalid_query, 404 usgs_rejected, 502 usgs_unavailable, 504 usgs_timeout. Unknown parameters are a 400 `unknown_param`.

parameters.name: starttime
parameters.description: Limit to events on or after this time (UTC). `YYYY-MM-DD` (midnight UTC) or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(Z)`.

parameters.name: endtime
parameters.description: Limit to events on or before this time (UTC). Same formats as starttime.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Circle-search centre latitude (degrees). Requires longitude and maxradiuskm together; exclusive with the bounding-box keys.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Circle-search centre longitude (degrees). Requires latitude and maxradiuskm together.

parameters.name: maxradiuskm
parameters.description: Circle-search radius in kilometres (> 0, at most 20001.6 — half the Earth’s circumference). Requires latitude and longitude together.

parameters.name: minlatitude
parameters.description: Bounding-box south edge (degrees). Must be <= maxlatitude.

parameters.name: maxlatitude
parameters.description: Bounding-box north edge (degrees). Must be >= minlatitude.

parameters.name: minlongitude
parameters.description: Bounding-box west edge (degrees). Must be <= maxlongitude.

parameters.name: maxlongitude
parameters.description: Bounding-box east edge (degrees). Must be >= minlongitude.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 100; the adapter caps any larger value at 200).

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: Sort order of the returned events (default time = newest first).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Local switch, not forwarded to USGS: "query" returns matching events, "count" returns only the number of matching events (FDSN count endpoint).

502.description: Upstream failure with a structured reason

503.description: Provider unavailable (missing key / no data) with a structured reason
